question: B's age is 5 times the difference in ages of C and D. D's age is 10 years more than the age of B. If the age of C is 30 years, then the minimum age of D is _____ years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ B = 5(30 − D)

⇒ D = B + 10 ⇒ B = D − 10

⇒ Substitute: D − 10 = 5(30 − D)

⇒ D − 10 = 150 − 5D

⇒ 6D = 160

⇒ D = 160/6 = (80)/(3) 

∴ The correct answer is (80)/(3) years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

C = 30, B = 5(C − D), D = B + 10

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations and solve

**Calculation:**

⇒ B = 5(30 − D)

⇒ D = B + 10 ⇒ B = D − 10

⇒ Substitute: D − 10 = 5(30 − D)

⇒ D − 10 = 150 − 5D

⇒ 6D = 160

⇒ D = 160/6 = (80)/(3) 

**∴ The correct answer is (80)/(3) years.**
